nodes.label: Skill entry
nodes.purpose: Receives the invocation, resolves which mode to run and what the target is.
nodes.built: A single SKILL.md read into context by the Skill tool. Frontmatter carries only name and description; the body is an imperative numbered workflow.

nodes.label: Hard rules
nodes.purpose: Constrains what may become a node, an edge, or a payload.
nodes.built: A reference document loaded before drafting. Eight numbered rules, each one a refusal.
nodes.condition: Rules are advisory to the model; only the validator enforces anything mechanically.

nodes.label: Evidence pass
nodes.purpose: Drafts the board's groups, nodes, and edges from real code.
nodes.built: Model-driven, not scripted. Recon, then drafting, then grep-confirmation of every claimed boundary.

nodes.label: Payload harvest
nodes.purpose: Quotes three to five real data shapes from type definitions, fixtures, or samples.
nodes.built: Verbatim extraction only. Every payload carries the file and line range it was quoted from.
nodes.condition: A repo with no type definitions and no fixtures yields no payloads, and the board loses its moving dots.

nodes.label: model.json
nodes.purpose: Holds the whole board as reviewable, hand-editable data.
nodes.built: One JSON document conforming to the documented schema. The only handoff between the two passes.

nodes.label: Validator
nodes.purpose: Fails the run when any citation does not resolve on disk.
nodes.built: A dependency-free Python script. Checks schema, node cap, path existence, line bounds, and id resolution. Exits non-zero with a list.

nodes.label: Renderer
nodes.purpose: Substitutes the validated model into the hand-written board template.
nodes.built: A text substitution, deliberately not code generation. The template is authored once and never regenerated.

nodes.label: Board
nodes.purpose: The self-contained interactive page you open, pan, and click.
nodes.built: Inline CSS and vanilla JS over an SVG isometric projection. Zero external requests, so it survives the Artifact CSP.

nodes.label: Artifact
nodes.purpose: A private shareable URL for the same board.
nodes.built: The rendered file published through the Artifact tool. Redeploying the same path keeps the URL stable.

explainer.title: The Two-Pass Board
explainer.subtitle: how a repository becomes something you can point at
explainer.what:
This skill turns a codebase into an interactive isometric board. It runs in two passes with a hard gate between them.

The first pass is **evidence**. The model reads the repository and drafts a small set of responsibilities, the real paths between them, and a handful of data shapes quoted verbatim from type definitions or fixtures. Its only output is `model.json`.

The second pass is **render**. A validator refuses the model if any cited file or line range does not exist. Only then does a hand-written template get the model substituted into it.

The split is the whole point. Analysis is where judgement belongs, so the model does it. Drawing is where consistency belongs, so a template does it.
explainer.howToRead:
Hover anything for a plain description. The **HOW IT'S BUILT** tab gives the implementation, and **Condition** lists what is currently wrong with it.

Solid lines are control. Dashed lines are retry paths. Dotted lines are feedback. The moving dots are payloads: click one to read the exact snippet and the file it was quoted from.

The tall structures are the parts that refuse things.
